name: Motihari

queries.query: Motihari Bihar official cadastral map land records parcel GIS
queries.result: Found Bihar Government BhuNaksha, Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms, East Champaran district land-information pages, and Bihar GIS. BhuNaksha is the official cadastral mapping portal; its public service exposes administrative selections and map REST endpoints.

queries.result: Hindi-language discovery found the official Bihar BhuNaksha portal and the East Champaran/Motihari district land-information page. The public map interface identifies Purbi Champaran, Motihari Sadar, Motihari circle and मोतिहारी(122) mauza, but no safe public polygon response was retained.

portals.observation: Current public JavaScript uses /rest/Levels, /rest/MapInfo, /ScalarDatahandler and WMS endpoints. Administrative discovery returned Purbi Champaran code 02, Motihari Sadar code 01, Motihari circle code 01 and मोतिहारी(122) mauza code 0009.

portals.name: East Champaran district land-information services
portals.operator: District Administration, East Champaran, Government of Bihar
portals.observation: Official district page identifies the Motihari land-record office and links Bihar online Khata/Jamabandi services; it is local registry-custodian evidence, not a parcel-vector API.

requests.result: Public viewer HTML retrieved; current assets/configuration inspected. No login or credentials used.
SERVICE_PATH and public REST/WMS routing confirmed.
Returned Motihari selections, survey types and map/sheet choices. Cadastral Survey CS exposes map instance 06 and sheets 01/02.
Returned gisCode CS02010100091220601, CRS EPSG:32645, extent xmin 292180.8141, ymin 2949515.4383, xmax 294045.6768, ymax 2952300.3122. Sheet 02 also returned a valid EPSG:32645 extent.

requests.request: state=10; giscode=CS02010100091220601; bounded test points x=293000,y=2950000 and x=294000,y=2951000
requests.result: Returned JSON with safe response fields id and kide: opaque ids JgE86iG3TtmfMYCbCrRDeA / 0yvGk-lZTeq85i3YjrX-RA and plot numbers 1652 / 1215. No geometry or public field schema was included. The exact WUP point transforms to approximately EPSG:32645 x=292677.8654,y=2949025.3411, outside sheet 01's returned extent; this is not treated as citywide absence.
The direct bounded metadata attempt with the discovered plot numbers and levels returned the site's generic error page; no unsafe fields were requested.

registryBasis: Bihar's official BhuNaksha identifies the cadastral map service and Motihari administrative selections; the official East Champaran district page identifies the local Motihari land-record office and online land-record workflow. This establishes registry custody and public map access, not complete citywide parcel coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: BhuNaksha Bihar provides cadastral maps by district, subdivision, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance and sheet.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Motihari mauza (0009) was enumerated and two Cadastral Survey sheet extents were returned anonymously. No citywide completeness or feature-vector coverage was verified.

technicalBlocker: The current public BhuNaksha routes returned map extents and point-hit identifiers but not full polygon geometry or a queryable safe feature schema. WMS rendering was available, but raster output is not retained as parcel geometry.
remainingUncertainty: The viewer may expose polygon selection or geometry through a UI-specific route not discovered in this attempt. The exact WUP point was outside the tested sheet-01 extent; no exact-point miss or extent miss is used as evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later serial reviewer should independently qualify a stable native identity plus safe polygon geometry before any adapter admission.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
